notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Roadmap v1 deck (6 slides: cover, phasing rationale, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, milestones & owners). The cover and phasing-rationale slides surface engine totals (effort hours, cost, scenario, assumptions) and engagement context. Per-phase scope on slides 3-5 is consultant-authored — the engine does not expose per-phase splits, so each phase slide carries a static 'Phase N: ' heading and a single empty body bullet for human fill. Milestones reuse the engine's recommendations bullet list as a starting point; the owner table is intentionally blank for the team to fill in. seed: {"name":"Roadmap","version":"v1","kind":"ROADMAP"}
